root_node.question: Can you access the internet right now?

internal_access_check.question: Can you access internal websites like SharePoint or ServiceNow?

options.text: No, I cannot access internal sites either

external_connectivity_diagnostic.question: What error message are you seeing?

resolution.message: Try flushing your DNS cache: ipconfig /flushdns on Windows or sudo dscacheutil -flushcache on Mac.
Check if you're connected to the correct WiFi network. Try restarting your router and modem, then wait 2 minutes before trying again.

speed_test_diagnostic.question: Are you using Ethernet or WiFi?

resolution.message: Try a different ethernet cable. If the problem persists, contact your network team — there may be a switch port issue.

wifi_signal_check.question: How far are you from the access point?

resolution.message: Try connecting to a different WiFi network if available. If all networks are slow, there may be an AP issue — contact your network team.
Move closer to the access point or connect via ethernet if possible. Signal strength significantly impacts performance at distance.

specific_app_issue.question: Which specific application are you having trouble with?

resolution.message: Please specify the application name so I can provide targeted assistance.

internal_network_diagnostic.question: Have you tried restarting your computer and network adapter?

resolution.message: Since internal networks are also affected, please contact the IT helpdesk for further assistance with potential network outages.

options.text: No, I haven't tried that yet

resolution.message: Please restart your computer and try again. If the issue persists after restart, contact the IT helpdesk.
